failures.criterion: Architect's ruling for point (3) (Envoy 3d1ba166): with no row, a repeated text is matched in order only when the version and the live document hold the same number of copies of it, in the same relative order; otherwise every copy stays unmatched until a settlement, and a paragraph typed after the close is never dated version 1, neither while closed nor after the reopen. Control: with equal counts and no edits to them, every copy resolves at version 1
failures.evidence: Red test TestAClosedDocumentsRepeatedTextWithNoRowIsMatchedOnlyWhenItsCountsAgree, commit c12da9a2 in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/block_index_test.go. Command: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://… go test -count=1 -run TestAClosedDocumentsRepeatedTextWithNoRowIsMatchedOnlyWhenItsCountsAgree ./internal/dispatch/docs/. Head: FAIL 'spec paragraph 5cc084b3-… "Same." is dated 1 (text at version 1 true) while closed; the version holds "Same." 3 times and the live document 4, so no copy may be matched'. Real surface (dep_r5): main 1357b95c closed ED-1 with version 1 'Same. / Same. / Other. / Same.' and an unsettled 'Same.' typed after 'Other.'. On the head deploy, the tick logged documents=1 owed_documents=0; the typed fe1ed832 is dated v1 and its @v1 pin answers 'Unchanged since version 1'; the original third 'Same.' 52d7159e answers 'No block'. After the reopen, 52d7159e is dated v2 and fe1ed832 stays v1. Cause: closedVersionBlocks' difflib text step inside each gap matches repeated text with no row, against its own comment 'a repeated paragraph is never given another's id'. Accepted limit (architect): an original copy left unmatched may be dated to the reopen's version.
